import pandas as pd
xl = pd.ExcelFile('budget.xlsx')
print('Sheets:', xl.sheet_names)
for s in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name=s)
    print('---', s, '---')
    print(df.to_string())
"

cd "$(pwd)" && python3 -c "
import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    print('Files:', z.namelist())
    # shared strings
    shared = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall('m:si', ns):
            shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')))
    print('Shared strings:', shared)
    for name in z.namelist():
        if re.match(r'xl/worksheets/sheet\d+\.xml', name):
            root = ET.fromstring(z.read(name))
            print('---', name, '---')
            for row in root.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
                cells = []
                for c in row:
                    ref = c.get('r'); t = c.get('t'); v = c.find('m:v', ns)
                    val = v.text if v is not None else ''
                    if t == 's' and val != '':
                        val = shared[int(val)]
                    cells.append(f'{ref}={val}')
                print(' | '.join(cells))
"

cd "$(pwd)" && python3 -c "
import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
expenses = []
for c in root.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}c'):
    ref = c.get('r')
    if ref and ref[0] == 'C' and ref[1:].isdigit():
        r = int(ref[1:])
        if 11 <= r <= 22:
            v = c.find('m:v', ns)
            expenses.append((ref, float(v.text)))
print('Expense cells:', expenses)
print('Total:', sum(x[1] for x in expenses))
"
